Recommended certification pathway

Australian Institute for NDT (AINDT) administers ISO 9712 in Australia. ASNT SNT-TC-1A is widely accepted in CSG-LNG and mining work led by US-owned operators (Santos JV partners, Glencore).

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.

What drives NDT training demand in Brisbane

Brisbane serves the Queensland CSG-to-LNG chain — the three Curtis Island trains and their upstream gathering — alongside the Bowen Basin coal industry, its heavy-haul railways, and the state's power fleet. Every one of those assets is examined on intervals set by code, and the examinations must be performed by certified personnel — which is what creates continuous local demand for qualified technicians, and continuous pressure on employers to develop them.

Which methods to train first in this market

Training investment should follow the local work. In Brisbane that means UT on cryogenic alloys, RT to demanding acceptance criteria, and PT for the stainless and nickel systems; in the mining sector, UT on structures and wear components, MT on ground-engaging and lifting equipment; and where power work features, UT including phased array on rotors and headers, MT during outages, and eddy current on condenser tubing. A candidate who certifies against what local employers actually examine is employable months sooner than one who spreads across every method thinly.

Which certification scheme employers here expect

AS/NZS standards and AINDT certification are the baseline, with Queensland's coal mining safety legislation adding site competency requirements; LNG operators run integrated turnaround regimes where NDT slots are booked far ahead.

For a candidate this decides the route before any course is booked: train toward the scheme your target employers name in their contracts. Where both employer-based (SNT-TC-1A) and central (ISO 9712 / PCN) certification circulate, the central certificate travels with you between employers — worth weighing against the faster employer-based route. How ASNT certification works · ISO 9712 vs SNT-TC-1A.

Levels, honestly explained

Level I performs calibrations and examinations under supervision — the entry point, usually reached in one method first. Level II sets up, interprets against the code and signs the report; it is the level contracts in Brisbane actually specify. Level III writes and approves procedures and qualifies the Level I/IIs — the level a growing inspection function eventually needs to own or engage. Progression is training hours plus documented experience hours, so anyone already working under supervision moves faster than a cold start.
